actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Keep the pool growing and avoid free‑riding.

answer.explanation: Wallet is 110, above 30% threshold, so baseline 80% contribution applies (88). Average contribution is ~60% (>45%), so no extra increase needed. Constitution requires a norm broadcast in round 1.

message.reasoning: We need to follow constitution. Our wallet 110, >30% initial (30). Baseline 80% of wallet = 88. Contribute at least 80%. Round avg? contributions: sum = 360, per agent share 90, so avg contribution = 360/6=60. That's 60% of endowment average. 60% >45% so we revert to baseline 80% contribution. So contribute 88 (80% of 110). Also broadcast norm at first round? Already round1, constitution says broadcast at first round and every 5 rounds. So we should broadcast. We can both contribute and broadcast (max one each). So actions: contribute 88, broadcast message encouraging fair contributions. Explanation.
